load_config_from_yaml: load an OpenEvolve configuration from a YAML file using Config.from_yaml or load_config
create_config_from_dict: create an OpenEvolve Config object from a Python dictionary using Config.from_dict
configure_llm_models: configure LLM model ensembles with primary and secondary models using LLMConfig
save_config_to_yaml: save an OpenEvolve Config object to a YAML file using Config.to_yaml
configure_database_evolution: configure the evolutionary algorithm parameters like population size and island count using DatabaseConfig
